Package neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.hybrid

Class HybridStepResult

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.hybrid.HybridStepResult
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class HybridStepResult extends Object implements Serializable
Snapshot of the hybrid production model at one point in time: well operating points, node pressures, field totals and solver diagnostics.
Version:
1.0
Author:
ESOL

  • Constructor Details

    • HybridStepResult

      HybridStepResult(double timeDays, boolean converged, int iterations, double pressureResidualBar, boolean calibrated, double largestOffsetChangeBar, int allocationPasses, String bindingConstraint, long liftEvaluations, long referenceEvaluations, double solveSeconds, Map<String,Double> nodePressures, List<HybridStepResult.WellResult> wells)
      Creates a snapshot.
      Parameters:
      timeDays - model time in days
      converged - whether the well-network iteration converged
      iterations - number of well-network iterations of the last solve
      pressureResidualBar - largest node pressure residual in bar
      calibrated - whether the lift curves were corrected against the reference models at this step
      largestOffsetChangeBar - largest change of a lift curve offset in bar at this step
      allocationPasses - number of facility-capacity allocation passes
      bindingConstraint - name of the binding facility constraint, or an empty string
      liftEvaluations - cumulative number of surrogate lift evaluations
      referenceEvaluations - cumulative number of reference lift evaluations
      solveSeconds - wall time of the solve in seconds
      nodePressures - node pressures in bara keyed by node name
      wells - well results
